> After Hours Studio is a New York creative direction and design office for beauty, fashion and lifestyle brands. We make hot brands smarter and smart brands hotter.
> After Hours Studio: Creative direction & design office, New York. For fashion, beauty, wellness and lifestyle brands.
Small team, big ideas, questionable name. We make brands worth knowing, things worth having and ideas worth talking about.

Office hoursAfter hours

We’re drawn to businesses playing in the worlds of culture, community and consumer. Usually that lands in fashion, beauty, wellness and lifestyle. We tend to get the call at three key moments: when someone’s building something from the ground up, when something familiar needs to feel new again, or when there’s a moment worth talking about. A product, a pop-up or a production. Digital or physical, big or small.

From early-stage founders to household names, we like close teams, good ideas and people who care about making good things, and making them well. Sound like you? We’d love to hear from you.

After Hours is open for business worldwide. Will travel (first class only). Please note we do observe office hours. The name was an oversigh
